Extra legs, extra toes, unusual faces, folded ears, missing tails, strange body shapes, and completely unexpected coat patterns can all result from genetic mutations or unusual development before birth.

In this video, we explore some of the most bizarre-looking cats and explain what actually causes their unusual appearances.

These cats may look strange at first, but behind every unusual feature is a fascinating story about genetics, development, and evolution.
